justice: Most of the visible street width is occupied by parked cars on both sides, while no dedicated sidewalk is clearly visible, indicating an uneven allocation of space away from pedestrians.

safety: The lane is narrow and lined with parked cars on both sides, which can reduce sightlines and create conflicts when vehicles or pedestrians move through the remaining central space.
